profile.headline: Intermediate Software Engineer at Publix Super Markets
profile.jobTitle: Intermediate Software Engineer - I/S Access Analysis and Reporting
profile.summary: SQL Server Developer experienced in report creation using SQL Server Reporting Services and Tableau. Process ETL data transforms to SQL Server using SQL Server Integration Services and SAP HANA. Build and support MS SQL Server databases and MS Access databases interfacing with MS SQL Servers.  Maintain and support ASP.Net websites interfacing with SQL Server databases.

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer - I/S Access Analysis and Reporting
Business Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
Merchandising Systems Specialist- Business Intelligence Analyst				(2019 – 2020)
Responsible for supporting all Merchandising department processes.  These include SSRS reports, SSIS processes, SQL data extracts and supporting the SQL Server Merchandising database and several MS Access databases. Redesign and rebuild the Merchandising Event Planner in Outsystems 11from an MS Access database.

SQL Developer 										(2018 – 2019)
Build and support SSRS reporting for the company.  Program and troubleshoot SQL views, Stored Procedures and Functions that feed reports. Respond to support requests for SQL query issues, SSIS and SSRS package creation and review.

positions.title: SQL Programmer
positions.description:
Delivered and executed reporting solutions for 10+ internal customer departments.  Managed SQL database design and implementation.  Consulted with end users to test and debug reports and data extracts to meet client needs. Analyzed test results and recommend modifications to the applications to meet project specifications. 
•	Built ETL processes for SQL Server from various data sources for further dissemination into reporting solutions for multiple accounting functions.
•	Programmed SAP data extracts to SQL Server such as the following:
o	Accounts Payable Past Due
o	Accounts Receivable Current Activity
o	Canada Service Billing Invoicing
o	Deferred Contracts Tracking
o	Full Service Commissions quarterly calculations
•	Designed and drafted database schema for each reporting solution.
•	Wrote user documentation related to each completed reporting solution.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Engineered application creation and supported internal customer software solutions for Financial
Shared Services. Coordinated and executed all phases of the product development life cycle from project planning to user acceptance testing.  Took ownership of finished projects ensuring new software processes meet customer requirements.
•	Programmed Visual Basic.Net console applications to run data extract processes from SAP or Basis to SQL 
Server automatically and on schedule. 
•	Built and supported MS Access 2010 databases interfacing with SQL Server 2008 via ADO and VBA. 
•	Developed SQL Server databases in conjunction with ASP.Net developers.
•	Built email import processes using MS Excel spreadsheets for data extract to SQL Server via MS Outlook.

positions.title: Staff Accountant-General Ledger
positions.description:
Ensured complete and systematic accounting of receipts and disbursements for Mid America. Processed a variety of complex clerical and bookkeeping tasks, applying generally accepted procedures to the preparation and maintenance of accounting records. Booked monthly debits, credits and accruals into SAP R/3 accounting system.
Analyzed Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable activity for all Business Units in the U.S. and Canada. 
•	Assisted in month-end close procedures, including analysis of Expense and Balance Sheet accounts, book to budget and accruals. 
•	Processed monthly Balance sheet and Expense account reconciliations. 
•	Analyzed Balance Sheet and P&L accounts and explained variances to budget. Researched and provided answers to any queries from Business Units concerning entries.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Provided technical support, performed trouble-shooting functions and resolved customer issues. Performed system installations for new customers.  Converted existing customer datasets from old accounting software programs to Data Pro Accounting software for new installations. Debugged and tested new installations for customer use.
•	Assisted customers in solving via e-mail, fax or telephone all questions or problems pertaining to the proper operation of Data Pro Accounting Software for all aspects of accounting, including Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Inventory, Job Costing, Report Writer and Payroll. 
•	Implemented new installations of Data Pro Accounting Software for new customers.
•	Provided customer training on-line and on-site.

positions.title: Staff Accountant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Assigned to Health First, a Health Insurance company.  Working in all aspects of accounting including month end closing, reconciliation of intercompany accounts, creating amortization schedules and analyzing revenue, expense and fixed asset accounts. Led the conversion of fixed assets from MS Excel spreadsheets to Great Plains Fixed Assets module.

positions.title: Accounting Systems Manager
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Co-ordinate the migration of Coalco’s accounting systems from QuickBooks to SunSystems Accounting Software running on Oracle 8i database. Setup and maintain Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and General Ledger.  Instruct users on operation of system.  Create reports for management using SunSystems and Vision5.  Assist CFO in managing accounting operations.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Value Added Reseller for Sun Systems Accounting software. Design solutions, deploy, install and configure Sun Systems for new and existing clients on Windows NT4, Microsoft SQL Server 7.0 & 6.5 & ISAM platforms.  Support and troubleshoot for Sun Systems.  Coordinate with sales department to advise potential clients about technical issues concerning their purchase and installation of SunSystems. Performed demos to existing client base, which resulted in the purchase of other Sun Systems products and the purchase of consulting man-days. Systems Administrator for Resource Systems Inc. Windows NT4 office network (9 nodes plus laptops).  Supplied clients with new business information, support and product installation.

projects.title: Canada Service Billing
projects.description: Builds invoices for billing of any service done on Coca Cola equipment in Canada. Build VB.Net interface from Basis(AS400) to SQL Server for invoice information.  Build VB.Net interface with SAP for Accounts Receivable records to reconcile SAP data to Basis data.

projects.title: Accounts Payable Past Due Invoice Reporting
projects.description: Build SSRS reporting for Accounts Payable Past Due invoices for the United States and Canada. Built VB.Net interface with SAP to extract data to SQL Server.  Send emails automatically invoice processors and their managers weekly to notify them that they have Past Due invoices to pay or settle.
